4832.title: Connect response deadline includes request upload
4832.rootCauseOneLine: Both Connect HTTP paths start a fixed 30-second response-header deadline before uploading the request body and reject delayed headers with HTTP 504.
4832.proposedFix: Choose bounded upload and model-route response-header budgets and enforce them in both Connect transport paths; moving the timer alone does not address delayed post-upload headers.
4832.caveats: The deterministic transport mechanism is verified in two clean checkouts. Actual large-context model-call timing, retry behavior and compaction failure were not measured. Timeout policy is a product decision, so no simple-fix PR was opened.
